newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB says margins under pressure.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB says margins under pressure.

text.p: National Australia Bank (NAB) said on Thursday that interest margins remained under pressure in all markets but that the group's strong focus on business fundamentals and its international spread of banking and financial services augured well for the future.

"Competitive pressure on interest margins remains in all markets. However, our continued emphasis on sound management practices, cost control and aggressive marketing will remain priorities," NAB managing director Don Argus said.
NAB earlier reported a net profit of A$582 million for the three months to end-December from A$513 million a year ago.
Argus said in a statement that the group continued to perform well in the first quarter.

"Earnings growth was achieved by a combination of cost containment, strong credit management and successful marketing of financial products to key segments of the market both in Australia and overseas," he said.
Argus said the group benefited from continued strength in the performance of its banking operations in New Zealand, the United States and Ireland.
The charge for doubtful debts fell 32.8 percent to A$39 million. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
